 Caleb Downs, DB (DAL) 
 Won't return, being checked for concussion
 Home   >  News 
 Nov 1 8:52pm 
 Downs has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Cardinals to be evaluated for a concussion, Jon Machota of The Athletic reports.
 Downs registered four tackles (two solo) before checking out of the contest. The Cowboys will likely clarify whether or not he's been diagnosed with a concussion no later than Wednesday, when the team releases its first Week 9 injury report.
